'''Finn Vaal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] who lived in the era of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Son of [[Zhari Vaal|Zhari]] and [[Adari Vaal]], Finn lost his [[Parent/Legends|father]] in an accident when he was young, and he and his brother, [[Tona Vaal|Tona]], were left to be raised by their [[Eulyn|grandmother]], as their mother was often away on [[Geologist/Legends|geology]] work. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Adari Vaal happened across a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of crashed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who claimed to be the Keshiri [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]]. Finn's mother was honored, and, over the coming [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Finn became devoted to the supposed Skyborn. Although he was exempt from working on the labor crews building monuments and tributes to the Sith due to his exalted mother, Finn volunteered anyway, and he [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[4987 BBY]] when the scaffold on which he was working collapsed.

==Biography==
[[File:Duel_near_Omen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Finn Vaal's mother, Adari Vaal, on a uvak mount over his homeworld of Kesh]]
Finn Vaal, a [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He was the oldest son of [[Zhari Vaal|Zhari]] and [[Adari Vaal]], and had one younger brother, [[Tona Vaal|Tona]]. His [[Parent/Legends|father]], Zhari, a member of Kesh's ruling [[Neshtovar]], [[Death/Legends|died]] in an accident while riding an [[uvak]] beast when Finn was still young. After that, Finn, Tona, and his mother moved in with Adari's mother, [[Eulyn]]. Adari was often busy with her work as a [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]], so Finn and his younger brother were cared for by their grandmother. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Adari became notorious for teachings that ran contrary to the prevalent [[Keshiri religion]], and, after the [[Vaal family home]] came under siege by an angry mob, she fled into the [[Takara Mountains]] while Finn and the rest of the Vaal family took refuge at a [[Adari Vaal's uncle|relative's]] home. While in the mountains, Adari came across a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who proclaimed themselves to be the Keshiri [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]]. Adari Vaal was honored for her role in finding the supposed Skyborn, and Finn happily attended the ceremony in which both her mother and the Skyborn were exalted in the [[Circle Eternal]] plaza in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]].<ref name="skyborn" />

By the time Finn came of age, the Sith were firmly entrenched as the rulers of Kesh. Many Keshiri set to work on labor crews, building monuments and the like glorifying the Sith. Although Finn, as the son of the honored Adari Vaal, did not have to work, he insisted on joining one of these crews once he was old enough, eventually getting his way. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4987 BBY]], a scaffold on which Finn was working collapsed, killing him. Adari rushed his lifeless body to Sith leader [[Yaru Korsin]] in the [[Kesh Sith Temple]], hoping that Korsin could resurrect Finn with [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], but the Sith leader was unable to do so. The incident destroyed Adari's faith in the Sith and drove her to lead the [[Keshiri resistance]], which secretly opposed the Sith.<ref name="savior" /> Years later, regretful passages about Finn and his brother Tona were found in [[Adari's personal memoirs|his mother's personal memoirs]], written during her [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the far-off continent of [[Alanciar]], after the disintegration of her resistance.<ref name="pandemonium">{{StoryCite|story=Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium|book=Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith: The Collected Stories|stext=''Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium''|smanual=1}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a youth, Finn Vaal was rambunctious, and it was a challenge for his caretakers to get him to sleep. He dearly loved his mother, despite the fact that she was usually unable to care for him. Both he and his brother, Tona, took after their father, but not in a positive way according to Adari&mdash;she regarded Finn as dim-witted and no kinder than her late husband had been.<ref name="skyborn" /> By the time Finn came of age, he was devoted to the Sith, so much so that he decided to labor on one of their work crews even though he was exempt from service.<ref name="savior" />

==Behind the scenes==
Finn Vaal first appeared in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', a [[2009]] [[eBook]] by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="skyborn" /> In ''Skyborn'', Finn is described as Adari Vaal's oldest child, but in ''Savior'' he is said to be the youngest. In an email interview dated [[December 11]], [[2013]], Miller confirmed that Finn was indeed the eldest son of Adari Vaal, as first mentioned in ''Skyborn''. He also acknowledged that the description of Finn as the youngest in ''Savior'' was an error.<ref name="JJM interview">{{EmailCite|email=File:Miller interview Dec 11 2013 001.jpg|creator=[[John Jackson Miller]]|date=2013-12-11}}</ref> Thus, this article uses the ''Skyborn'' placement.
